name: Kobold
summary: Small, dragon-worshipping reptiles who make up for their size with numbers, traps and teamwork.

age.summary: Kobolds mature at 6 and can live up to 120 years, though few do.

size.description: Kobolds are 2 to 3 feet tall and weigh 25 to 35 pounds.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Draconic.

features.name: Darkvision
features.summary: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of gray only).

features.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
features.summary: As an action, cower pathetically. Until the end of your next turn, allies attacking enemies within 10 feet of you have advantage. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.summary: You have advantage on attacks against a creature if an ally that isn't incapacitated is within 5 feet of it.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.summary: In direct sunlight you have disadvantage on attack rolls and on sight-based Perception checks.
